scientific_integrity: Analytical stationary moment criterion and proofs are supplied. Executable finite checks corroborate algebra, not infinite-time convergence; priority risk exists because earlier work includes general affine-reset moment formulas and pairwise moment equations.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous nonnegative N-site PDMP with 0<m<r, independent local Poisson resets, positive reset level, no Brownian noise and nonnegative mean-field redistribution; no claim of full-law convergence or higher-moment stability.
title: Critical covariance locking and the finite-size variance frontier in local-reset growth
